scope: Additive TH18 Town Hall passive/destructible scope record.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
sources.limitations: Confirms that Town Hall is no longer a defensive building. It does not publish a TH18 weapon because none is active, nor collision, destruction timing or star-resolution chronology.

sources.title: Town Hall payload
sources.limitations: Pins passive building levels and footprint but no current client destruction timeline.

support.note: Core materializes Town Hall as targetable/destructible passive TH18 building and resolves stars through shared state. No Town Hall weapon is activated because the official current record says it is not defensive.

known_uncertainties: The published record does not give collision, destruction animation, exact star-resolution ordering or a distinct TH18 passive-building asset contract.
No inactive historical Town Hall weapon mode is used as a TH18 proxy.
conclusion: Town Hall remains integrated as an in-scope passive destructible building; its historic weapon is deliberately absent from TH18 combat.
